name: Undefeated x Nike Air Force 1 Low 'Pink Prime'
story_html: The Undefeated x Nike Air Force 1 Low ‘Pink Prime’ is taken from the AF1 Multi-Color Patent project, a collaborative series celebrating the 40th anniversary of the iconic silhouette. Taking cues from Undefeated’s Nike Dunk High NL from 2005, this pair features a paneled patent leather upper in a clashing mix of powder blue, brown, black and purple. Color-popped accents arrive via a translucent pink Swoosh, matching ‘UNDFTD’ lace dubrae, and a bright yellow tongue tag marked with Undefeated’s Five Strikes logo. The insignia is repeated on the lateral heel. Anchoring the sneaker is a durable rubber cupsole in a tonal green finish.
